title: Ring CP: cyclic all-to-all K/V rotation

verification.label: Measured TorchTitan/PyTorch native CP · rank 0 CUDA streams
verification.implementation: TorchTitan Qwen3 model with PyTorch 2.9 native context_parallel, FlashAttention, CP=4, cyclic all-to-all K/V rotation
verification.workload: Two dense Qwen-shaped layers, hidden 4096, 64 query heads, 4 KV heads, sequence 16384, BF16; displayed detail is Layer 0
verification.measurement: 68.675 ms full CUDA-event step; 66.961 ms displayed semantic GPU window
verification.timeline: Exact rank-0 Nsight compute-stream and NCCL-stream timestamps; Layer 1 is explicit fixed context.

description: This uses the same native ring-attention math as the all-gather task, but each iteration cyclically permutes the current concatenated K/V shard with an NCCL all-to-all primitive. It does not transpose sequence into attention heads and is therefore not Ulysses.

Forward has three K/V rotations for four CP ranks. Backward interleaves three K/V rotations needed by partial FlashAttention backward with four dK/dV rotations that accumulate and return gradients to the original shard owners.
The trace shows measured Layer 0 detail. Fixed omission bands hide Layer 1 compute and communication so they provide elapsed context without demonstrating the Layer 0 answer.
